title: fix(rootless): preserve systemd socket activation fds on re-exec
body:
When podman.service is socket-activated at user login it races with the other podman units to set up the rootless pause process.  If the re-executed child loses the race for the pause PID file, podman falls back to reexec_userns_join(), which forks again.
